propositions: The description cap should read from config key verify.max_ticket_description_chars (default 8000) and be shared between the plan-review admission guard, completion precheck, and new save-time warning.

When a ticket is saved (create or edit) with description exceeding the configured cap and the plan-review claim gate is enabled for the project, a warning must be displayed at save time stating length, cap, and that claim requires passing review.
The save-time warning must never block or alter the write; it is computed after the event is appended and degrades gracefully to None on any error.
The warning must be surfaced on all three surfaces: CLI (stderr), library (rebar logger), and MCP (result field on CreateResultOut/WriteAckOut).
No warning is emitted when the gate is disabled, when description is within cap, or when ticket type is exempt from plan review.
